name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-settings
description: Prototype: P4.4 fleet-settings — the companion /fleet-settings page on the fleet HTTP server (issue #26, orchestration-v3 §4.4). Sessions tab reads the dsh session ledger ($DSH_HOME/sessions, zstd JSONL) via the canonical JsonlSessionPersistence with per-log status (open turn = running) + title/updatedAt, with resume = the session.prompt RPC seam (POST /api/session.prompt, mode queue) and archive = the workspace.archiveSession RPC seam + a durable UI overlay marker. Fleet settings tabs: agents (fleet-agent profiles CRUD + enabled toggle), teams/rooms (fleet-teams members/grants/rooms), budgets (fleet-budget caps + status), policy (fleet-policy postures). The dsh settings dialog is NOT extensible (client-side slots in the read-only web bundle) so this companion page is the sanctioned settings surface. Served via ctx.webServer /fleet-settings* when composed + a standalone fleet-settings-server bin (port 3094).
